title: When the World Says Fear, God Says Peace
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message about the impact of our words and actions, and how we can be used by God to bring hope and transformation to those around us, no matter where we are in the world. In this sermon, Pastor Chris shares a personal story of how God used his teaching to change a community in Nicaragua, and reminds us that we all have the power to touch lives and bring glory to God. Don't miss this inspiring and challenging message about the power of faith and obedience.
